thread:
kiran_support: Customer (AcmeAir) reports SSO failures after IdP rotated signing certs last night. Error in our logs: `SAML signature validation failed: cert fingerprint mismatch`. Ticket SUP-4321.

jamie_infra: Can you paste the full SAMLResponse error log and the ACS URL they are asserting?

kiran_support: Log snippet from our proxy:
```
2024-11-02T03:12:11Z auth: request_id=... saml: verifySignature: fingerprint mismatch, expected=AB:CD:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD got=EF:01:23:45:67:89:01:23:45:67:89:01:23:45:67:89
saml: recipient mismatch: acs_received=https://app.acmeair.com/saml/acs vs sp_config=https://app.acmeair.com/sso/acs
```

olivia_sre: That recipient/ACS URL difference looks like the root cause. IdP metadata likely still points to old ACS path or they rotated and reissued metadata with url-encoding/ordering differences.

kiran_support: I asked customer for their IdP metadata. They sent metadata URL: https://idp.acmeair.net/metadata.xml

maria_support: Can we pull it and check certs? I can run:
```
curl -sS https://idp.acmeair.net/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath "string(//ds:X509Certificate)" - 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\s\+//g' | openssl x509 -inform der -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```

jamie_infra: FYI openssl expects PEM; their X509 is base64 DER inside XML. Use:
```
echo "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n$(curl -s https://idp.acmeair.net/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath 'string(//ds:X509Certificate)' -)\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----" | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```

kiran_support: Ran that — fingerprint in metadata: SHA256:EF:01:23:45:67:89:01:23:45:67:89:01:23:45:67:89. Our cached fingerprint was SHA256:AB:CD:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD, so cert changed. Also metadata contains two AssertionConsumerService entries with different URLs. Their app posted to index 1 (https://app.acmeair.com/saml/acs) but our SP config was pinned to index 0 (https://app.acmeair.com/sso/acs).

olivia_sre: Two issues: (1) mismatched ACS recipient -> recipient mismatch; (2) cert changed -> signature verification fails until we refresh cached metadata. We cache metadata for 1h by default. Looks like IdP rotated certs right after our fetch so we had stale certs.

kiran_support: Customer needs immediate access. Proposed temporary fixes: a) ask IdP to re-add old cert (not ideal), b) update our SP to accept both ACS endpoints (add alt_acs mapping), c) force metadata refresh from the console and invalidate cache for this tenant.

jamie_infra: I can add alternate ACS for them; requires a quick rollout. @olivia_sre can you approve emergency change so SP accepts both recipients for tenant acmeair? We'll add an audit entry and revert after confirmation.

olivia_sre: Approve. Jamie, patch and restart auth-proxy worker for tenant. Also extend metadata cache TTL to 5m for this tenant while they finish rotation.

maria_support: Communicated workaround and requested customer to retry and share SAML tracer screenshot. Ticket SUP-4321 updated.

deploy-bot: deploy started for auth-proxy patch (job id: dp-58432). ETA ~2m.

kiran_support: Customer confirms SSO success after deploy. Follow-ups: - verify metadata fetch logs around rotation window - add fingerprint-mismatch alerting to detect stale caches - docs: how to add alternate ACS in tenant settings + rollback plan.

olivia_sre: I'll open ENG-789 to track fingerprint alerting and metadata cache improvements. Leaving this thread open until ENG ticket exists.
